BATUMI, Georgia (March 17, 2018) The skyline of Batumi, Georgia, from aboard the Harpers Ferry-class dock landing ship USS Oak Hill (LSD 51) as the ship arrives for a scheduled port visit March 17, 2018. Oak Hill, homeported in Virginia Beach, Virginia, and the 26th Marine Expeditionary Unit are conducting naval operations in the 6th Fleet area of operations. (Marine Corps Photo by Staff Sgt. Dengrier M. Baez/Released)
